key_features: Chipset: AMD B450 for stable performance.
Memory: 2 DIMM slots supporting dual-channel DDR4 memory up to 3200MHz (OC).
Graphics: 1 PCIe 3.0 x16 slot for high-performance GPU support.
Storage: 4 SATA3.0 6Gb/s ports for ample storage connectivity.
LAN: Realtek RTL8111H 1000M LAN providing 10/100/1000Mb Ethernet.
Audio: ALC662 6-channel audio chipset for immersive sound.
